# Assessing the Quality of Biomedical Boolean Search Strings Generated by Prompted and Unprompted Models Using ChatGPT: A Pilot Study

**Source:** 2024; peer-reviewed study

## Bibliographic information

- **Authors:** Robyn B. Reed, Derek J. Barnett
- **Year:** 2024
- **DOI:** 10.1080/02763869.2024.2440848
- **URL:** https://doi.org/10.1080/02763869.2024.2440848
- **Publication status:** Published in Medical Reference Services Quarterly 44(1), 31-40
- **Source category:** peer-reviewed-study
- **Record type:** journal-article
- **Notes:** Pilot study using four review topics, three ChatGPT-based systems, and five runs per topic. Mean recall was 6.9%-9.4% and mean precision 28.2%-35.3% when compared with published PubMed searches; outputs varied substantially between runs and sometimes required syntax cleanup. Published search strategies are imperfect reference standards and only four reviews were tested.
